records.title: Italian Government Scholarships for Foreign Students and Italians Living Abroad (2026–2027)
records.summary: MAECI scholarships for on-site study, training or research at public or legally recognised private Italian institutions. The call covers Master's, AFAM, PhD, supervised research and intensive Italian language/culture programmes; first-cycle Costruiamo il futuro awards are renewals only.
records.study_levels: Master's, AFAM (first/second cycle), PhD, research, Italian language/culture
